full_judgment:
c. Plaintiff-petitioners on 9-11-1987 laid a petition before Court for amendment of plaint seeking incorporation of relief that compromise decree in pursuance of a petition for compromise in Title Suit No. 226 of 1959 on the file of Court of First Munsiff, Bagerhat is fraudulent, illegal and not binding upon plaintiffs and, also, insertion of some facts and payment of court fee and other incidental reliefs. 

 6. Ran an eye over the contents embraced in Revision Petition. Glanced through the photo copies of the plaint of Title Suit No. 226 of 1959, Petition of Compromise plaint of Title Suit No. 86 of 1986 and Written Statement laid in the said suit and other papers annexed in Revision Petition as Annexures. Explored grounds pressed into service in support of Revision Petition. Took a mental note of the submissions advanced from the side of plain-tiffs-petitioners. Ruminated laws and principles governing amendment of plaint. Studied the order impugned in Revision Petition. 

 8. Plaintiffs-petitioners by way of amendment, sought relief in respect of a compromise decree which they allege to be forged and, also, insertion of some material facts in obtaining the compromise decree and some other incidental reliefs. The proposed amendment does not at all demonstrate that complexion of the suit has been totally changed and the amendment is not in consonance with the laws and principles controlling amendment of plaint. Petition for amendment of plaint was required to be accepted and allowed by learned Assistant Judge. 

 D. Learned Senior Assistant Judge, Bagerhat Sadar, Bagerhat shall dispose of the suit within six (6) months positively from the date of receipt of this Judgment. Learned Senior Assistant Judge shall be absolutely free in deciding the fate of the compromise decree i.e. the character of the compromise decree, whether it is forged or genuine. Learned Senior Assistant Judge, Bagerhat Sadar shall, also, report compliance of the order of this Court to Registrar of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh immediately after the disposal of the suit.
